runtime_invariants.claim: source_goto_label increments _source_entry_serial and renders destination before queuing frame script; every TimelinePreview frame advance/play_source_frame also increments it.
defer_frame_script queues the destination, consumes _source_goto_defer_advance_once on the next AI display dispatch, and returns once; no permanent freeze.
only an identical consecutive pending frame is coalesced; A->B->A is retained as a real re-entry.
placement_id plus parent_entry_serial yields a generation/instance id; a placement at the same depth/frame with a new entry serial receives a fresh generation.
named child/projectile local frames are stored independently with local_start, age, playing and source variables; root playhead is not used as a replacement clock when a local record exists.
a newly placed callback is not dispatched on its placement display tick; dispatch requires placed_tick < display_tick and callback identity/generation is snapshotted.
new PlaceObject jump window resets js/jumpinggg at placement frame, with enterFrame beginning on the next root frame.
